meta.review_notes: Camera and microphone access is not addressed in the privacy policy. For a language learning app that likely uses speech recognition, this is a notable omission and should be verified.

app.name: EF Hello: Learn English
app.description: An English language learning app offering personalized courses, interactive lessons, and progress tracking to help users improve their English skills.

verdict.one_liner: EF Hello collects extensive personal data and shares it broadly with advertising platforms and affiliates for marketing, but it does provide user rights and claims it does not sell your data.
verdict.summary: EF Hello collects a wide range of personal data including identity, location, device information, and payment details. It shares this data with advertising platforms, corporate affiliates, business partners, and social media companies for marketing and analytics. The app uses cookies, pixel tags, and tools like Salesforce Marketing Cloud to track your behavior and tailor marketing messages. While it provides GDPR and CCPA rights, explicitly states it does not sell data, and offers unsubscribe options, the extensive tracking and broad data sharing are significant concerns. Data is retained for 2-5 years after account closure.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The extensive data collection, broad sharing with advertising and marketing partners, and long retention periods make EF Hello a poor choice for privacy-conscious users. If you need a language learning app, consider alternatives with stronger privacy protections.

red.title: Data shared with many third parties for marketing
red.plain_english: Your personal data is shared with advertising platforms, corporate affiliates, business partners, social media companies, and IT providers. With your consent, it can also be shared with affiliates for their own marketing.

red.title: Extensive behavioral and marketing tracking
red.plain_english: The app uses cookies, pixel tags, and tools like Salesforce Marketing Cloud to track what you read, click, and forward. This data is used to send you targeted ads and tailor marketing messages based on your behavior.

red.title: Data kept for up to 5 years after you leave
red.plain_english: Your personal data is kept for 2-5 years after you close your account. Marketing data can be kept for up to 5 years after your last use, unless you explicitly withdraw consent.

red.title: Camera and microphone access not mentioned
red.plain_english: The privacy policy does not say whether the app accesses your camera or microphone. For a language learning app, this is a notable omission that makes it unclear what permissions the app requests.

red.title: Physical location is collected when enabled
red.plain_english: If you turn on location services, the app collects your physical location to provide personalized content and redirect you to local websites. Your location may also be collected during app crashes via Instabug.

green.title: Explicit no-sale policy under CCPA
green.plain_english: The privacy policy explicitly states that EF does not sell your personal information to third parties as defined under California privacy law.

green.title: User rights under GDPR and CCPA
green.plain_english: You can request access to your data, correct inaccurate information, ask for deletion, restrict processing, and receive a portable copy of your data. You can also object to direct marketing.

green.title: 16+ age requirement with deletion promise
green.plain_english: The app requires users to be at least 16 years old. If EF discovers a user under 16, they promise to delete the data as soon as possible.

green.title: Marketing unsubscribe option available
green.plain_english: You can opt out of marketing communications using unsubscribe links in emails or by contacting efhello@ef.com.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention whether the app accesses your camera or microphone.
categories.detail: For a language learning app, microphone access is likely used for speech recognition features, but the privacy policy is completely silent on camera and microphone permissions and data handling.
concerns: Policy is silent on camera and microphone access

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: If you enable location services, the app collects your physical location to provide personalized services and redirect you to local websites. Your location may also be collected during app crashes.
categories.detail: Location is collected only when enabled by the user. It is used for personalization, local website redirection, and may be captured by Instabug during crash reporting. There is no mention of location being shared with advertisers.
categories.policy_excerpt: Provided that you have enabled that function on your device, we collect the physical location of it to provide you with personalized location-based services and content.
concerns: Physical location collected when enabled
Location may be collected during crashes via Instabug

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not state that the app accesses or uploads your contacts or phonebook.
categories.detail: While the policy mentions receiving data about social media connections, there is no explicit mention of accessing your device's contacts or phonebook list.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: The app tracks what information and files have been downloaded to the mobile application, but this appears limited to app-specific content.
categories.detail: The policy mentions tracking files downloaded to the mobile application based on your device number. This appears to be limited to app-specific downloads rather than broad device storage access.
categories.policy_excerpt: we track and collect mobile application usage data, such as the date and time the mobile application on your device accessing our servers and what information and files have been downloaded to the mobile application based on your device number

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Your data is shared with advertising platforms, corporate affiliates for marketing, business partners, social media companies, and IT service providers. With consent, affiliates can use it for their own marketing.
categories.detail: The policy describes sharing with corporate affiliates, third-party service providers (including advertising platforms), business partners, social media platforms, and other third parties. Data is explicitly shared for marketing purposes, including direct marketing and telemarketing.
categories.policy_excerpt: We share Personal Data with third parties in connection with the delivery of services to you and the operation of our business... to advertising platforms... For the transmission and communication to third-party companies or other EF companies for their marketing purposes, including direct marketing activities and telemarketing.
concerns: Shared with advertising platforms
Shared with affiliates for their own marketing with consent
Shared with social media platforms when connected

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: The app collects extensive identity data including name, email, phone, birth date, gender, and social media account IDs. This data is used for marketing and shared with affiliates and advertising platforms.
categories.detail: Account creation requires providing name, contact details, birth date, gender, and country. Social media login links external profile data. This identity data is linked to marketing profiles and shared with advertising platforms and affiliates for marketing purposes.
categories.policy_excerpt: Name and contact details (e.g. postal and email address, telephone number)... Account information or user ID (e.g. user name, profile picture or social media account ID)... Country of residence or citizenship... Birth date... Gender... For the transmission and communication to third-party companies or other EF companies for their marketing purposes
concerns: Extensive identity data collected
Linked to marketing and advertising profiles
Social media login links external data

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: The app uses cookies, pixel tags, app usage tracking, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud to monitor your behavior and send you targeted marketing messages based on your interests.
categories.detail: Tracking includes cookies, pixel tags, mobile app usage data, email engagement tracking via Salesforce Marketing Cloud (opens, clicks, forwards), and social media network tracking. This data is used to tailor content and send targeted promotions.
categories.policy_excerpt: We also collect Personal Data: Through cookies... Through your use of a mobile application... To analyse and improve our offers by identifying usage trends, determining the effectiveness of our promotional campaigns and tailoring the EF Products experience and content based on your past activities... Salesforce Marketing Cloud's management software which maintains mailing lists and schedules and modifies email messages based on what recipients read, click-on or forward
concerns: Cookies and pixel tags used for tracking
Email behavior tracked via Salesforce Marketing Cloud
App usage data collected and analyzed for marketing
Social media network members tracked via cookies

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: The app requires users to be at least 16 years old, but the company does not actively verify ages. They promise to delete data if they discover an underage user.
categories.detail: The policy states users must be at least 16, but EF is not responsible for checking age. They sometimes do verification checks. If they learn a user is under 16, they promise to delete the data. Language learning apps may appeal to younger users.
categories.policy_excerpt: To use EF Products, you must be at least 16 years old. We are not responsible for checking your age but sometimes we still do verification checks. If we learn that you are under the age of 16 and that we have collected information about you without consent from your parent or guardian, we will delete the information as soon as possible
concerns: No strong age verification mechanism
Language learning apps may appeal to children

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: The app collects your IP address, MAC address, browser type, device info, and server logs when you use the service.
categories.detail: Standard collection of network and technical identifiers including IP address, MAC address, browser type and version, screen resolution, operating system, device manufacturer and model, and service provider information.
categories.policy_excerpt: Technical information, e.g. screen/user name, IP address, browser and device data, information collected through cookies, pixel tags and other technologies, server log file data, app usage data and location data, page views and website navigation
concerns: IP address and MAC address collected
Browsing activity tracked via server logs

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: The app collects your device ID, device model, screen resolution, and operating system info. Instabug also collects device data during crashes. This data is used for analytics and shared with advertising platforms.
categories.detail: Device information collected includes device ID, device model, screen resolution, OS name and version, browser type and version, and manufacturer. Instabug collects additional device data during crashes. This device data is used for analytics, marketing, and shared with advertising platforms.
categories.policy_excerpt: The application automatically collects certain information that does not personally identify users of it. This information includes, but is not limited to, information on the device such as device ID, device mode, time of failure and the physical location of a device at the time of a crash.
concerns: Device ID collected and used for analytics
Device data shared with advertising platforms
Instabug collects device data during crashes

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The app does not collect health or biometric data as part of its core service.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly states they do not generally seek to collect sensitive Personal Data, which includes health or medical condition. They would only collect such data with explicit consent if necessary for specific services.
categories.policy_excerpt: We do not generally seek to collect any sensitive Personal Data... health or medical condition

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: The app collects credit and debit card numbers, payment data, and bank account details. These are shared with IT providers that process payments.
categories.detail: The policy lists credit/debit card numbers, payment data, and bank account details as collected Personal Data. These are shared with third-party service providers for processing payments and managing customer relations.
categories.policy_excerpt: Credit and debit card number, payment data or bank account details... We share Personal Data with third parties in connection with the delivery of services to you... providers of IT systems in order to manage customer relations, process credit cards or other payment solutions
concerns: Payment card data collected directly
Shared with third-party payment processors

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can request access, correction, deletion, and portability of your data. However, your data may be kept for 2-5 years after account closure, and marketing data for up to 5 years after your last use.
categories.detail: The policy provides comprehensive GDPR and CCPA rights including access, correction, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection. However, data is retained for 2-5 years after account expiry for possible reactivation, and marketing data is kept for up to 5 years after last service. Deletion requires contacting efhello@ef.com.
categories.policy_excerpt: We will only keep your Personal Data for 2-5 years after the expiry of your account... We will keep limited parts of your Personal Data which are necessary for marketing purposes until you withdraw your consent, but in no event for longer than 5 years after your last completed service or delivery of product.
concerns: Data retained for 2-5 years after account closure
Marketing data kept for up to 5 years
Deletion requires contacting support

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: EF promises to post policy changes on its website and provide a prominent notice before implementing them. Where required by law, they will ask for your consent first.
categories.detail: The policy states that significant changes will be posted on the page with prominent notice prior to implementation, and prior consent will be sought where required by law. However, there is no explicit requirement for users to actively re-agree to changes.
categories.policy_excerpt: We will not significantly reduce your rights under this Privacy Policy without informing you. We will post any Privacy Policy changes on this page and, prior to implementing such changes, we will provide a more prominent notice. Where required by law, we will seek your prior consent to any change.
concerns: No explicit active re-agreement required for all changes
